title: Hop-depth-conditional chain-vs-peripheral supervision experiment (superseded)
description: SUPERSEDED by M005 after U015 was resolved: chain/path supervision is established prior art (MHGRN, Variational Reasoning) and must be treated as a control, not a contribution. This earlier formulation is retained for traceability but no longer recommended; its four-arm structure (isolated triple/path; chain; chain + peripheral; chain + shuffled at matched budget) is carried forward into M005.
why_differs: Superseded framing; see M005 for the version that credits chain supervision to prior art.
technical_mechanism: As M005: four matched-budget supervision views over the same targets, byte-identical templates, identical test-time context.
expected_benefit: Retained only as a record of the pre-U015 framing; M005 supersedes it by demoting the chain arm to a prior-art control and centering the test on peripheral context.
potential_novelty: Hedged: superseded - the chain effect is not novel, and the residual peripheral-context question is addressed in M005.
implementation_difficulty_basis: Same as M005: existing datasets, LoRA on an off-the-shelf model, no RL infrastructure.
experimental_difficulty_basis: Same as M005: matched-budget arms, shuffled-context control, hop-depth split, format-controlled scorer, multiple seeds.
main_risk: Presenting chain supervision as a contribution when it is prior art; M005 corrects this framing.
required_baselines: Shuffled/unrelated-context arm at matched token budget
